description: Design a qPCR assay: primer pairs under qPCR's own constraints (70-150 bp product, tightly matched Tm) each with the best hydrolysis (TaqMan-style) probe that fits between them. The probe sits 6-12 °C above the warmer primer, never begins with G — a 5' guanine quenches the reporter even after the probe is cleaved — carries no run of four identical bases, and is reported on whichever strand has more C than G, with that strand named. A pair whose window holds no legal probe is still returned in order, because a SYBR assay needs no probe and dropping it would answer the probe question when the primers were what was asked for. For an ordinary PCR product use primer_design, which has the wider amplicon range.

ampliconMax.description: Longest product (bp). Past ~200 bp the efficiency starts to fall.

ampliconMin.description: Shortest product (bp). qPCR wants a short amplicon so every cycle doubles.

maxReturn.description: Number of best assays to return.

targetEnd.description: 1-based inclusive end of the target region (optional).

targetStart.description: 1-based inclusive start of a region the product must span (optional).

template.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

tmMaxDiff.description: Max Tm difference within a pair (°C). Tighter than ordinary PCR.
